rules.rawLintCoverage: Hex colours, rgb()/rgba(), cubic-bezier() and N px/ms values outside {refs}, in every string except keys listed in rawLintExemptKeys

notGenerationApprovedReason: Tablet (810-1199.98px) was never measured on any route; do not author tablet-specific layout against it.
overrides: PageSpecs carry no per-instance style or token-override field (styling is owned by section/component contracts), so there is nothing to validate at the PageSpec layer; drift of this policy against the catalog is caught by verify_all.py.
